packageRules.description: Wait 14 days after a release before proposing it, for every update Renovate can date. Set here because a matching package rule overrides the top-level setting. Vulnerability fixes skip the wait.
Pinning a version already in use is not an upgrade, so it is not delayed.

customManagers.description: vendor/superpowers is a pinned copy of an upstream release. This moves sha= and tag= together across releases; CI re-syncs the tree from sha= and fails on any difference, so a bump also needs scripts/sync-superpowers.sh run on its branch. ignorePaths above restates the preset's list without **/vendor/** so that this file is read.
